headline: Dungeon runs now show who won each boss's loot.

items.text: This update brings Chronicle 0.8.0: a dungeon run keeps each item the group rolled for under its boss, with who won it and what everyone chose.
It also brings Ryna Core 0.5.2, and the thanks on the About tab now name Rotus.

headline: Check for updates looks for new addons too.

items.text: "Check for updates" now also looks for new versions of Ryna's addons, so you no longer have to quit and reopen the app to get one. With the game open, a new addon goes in when the game closes.
This update brings Chronicle 0.7.0, which tracks your dungeon runs: time, experience, kills, bosses and what the loot was worth.

headline: Ryna's addons now update on their own.

items.text: The app keeps each Ryna addon up to date by itself, between app updates. A new version goes in the next time the game is closed.
Every addon now has its own version number, so the app and its addons no longer always match. That is expected.
This update brings Ryna Core 0.5.1 and the newest version of each mod you have on.

headline: Ryna's own addon is now called Ryna Core.

items.text: Ryna's addon is now "Ryna Core" in the game's AddOns list. Nothing you recorded is lost.
The Mods tab says when a mod needs a newer Ryna Core.
The app moves your addon folder and saved data to the new name, with the game closed.
The app has a new icon: Ryna herself.

headline: Ryna's menu, from the minimap button.

items.text: Click the minimap button for a menu: every section of Ryna's window, what's new, and Settings.
The minimap menu turns the meter and the threat bar on and off, and opens another meter window.

headline: Live meters and a threat bar, read from the game itself.

items.text: A live meter: damage, DPS, healing, HPS and more, to two decimals.
Click a meter's first line to choose what to show and which fight.
Up to four windows, locked together if you like, the threat bar too.
Hover a row to see what that player used.
A threat bar for your group, orange when someone is about to pull.
Announce a window to party, raid, guild or say.
Your recent fights in Ryna's window: who struck first, who died when, damage done and taken.
Characters shows where your gold and time played are, with a bar for each character.
History has a Play view: when you played, day by day and hour by hour.
A character's quest log, grouped as the game groups it, for your alts too.
Gold is no longer saved as 0 when you log out.
Item tooltips say how the auction low moved this week.
Mods are now named "Chronicle by Ryna", "Prices by Ryna" and so on.
This note: once after each update. /ryna news shows it again.
An older addon in your game folder is updated when the app starts.
Fights inside a dungeon are filed as dungeon fights, not open world.
A clearer message when macOS won't let Ryna read the save folder.
